items.q: Can I attend without entering the competition?
items.a: Yes. Register as an attendee and watch the keynote, the competition and your chosen workshop.

items.q: What time is it in my province?
items.a: 1–4 PM Eastern is 10 AM–1 PM Pacific, 11 AM–2 PM Mountain, 12–3 PM Central, 2–5 PM Atlantic and 2:30–5:30 PM in Newfoundland.

items.q: How do I get the Zoom link?
items.a: It is emailed to everyone who registers before December 25, along with a short pre-conference survey.
